reader.requirement: At --std 85 FINAL names the most inclusive control level of the report, one tied to no control data item: written first in the CONTROL clause (alone or before data-name-1) it is the highest level, it never takes a control break from a change of value at GENERATE, its CONTROL HEADING is processed once at the chronologically first GENERATE and its CONTROL FOOTING once as the last body group at TERMINATE (none when no GENERATE ran), its RESET ON FINAL counters reset only there, and a TYPE CH/CF FINAL or RESET ON FINAL is refused when FINAL is not in the CONTROL clause. The one witness covers only FINAL with one data-name and a CF FINAL at TERMINATE.

Edition.DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 a RESET ON operand may be the footing's own level (SR4 'must not be a lower level'), so RESET ON FINAL inside CF FINAL is admitted; from 2002 it must be strictly higher and is refused (COBOL6824)
at 85 a TYPE CH/CF without its operand and OR PAGE are refused (COBOL0900, ReportControlOperandForms2002)
at 85 the word ON/FOR before the TYPE operand (CF ON FINAL) is refused (COBOL0900)
asks only data-name operands (GateCobol85ControlName); FINAL is not asked at any edition

reader.notes: FINAL is bound as a control entry with no data item (EmitReportConstruction emits AddControl(true, a constant empty image, a no-op set)) at index 0, and DetectBreakLevel skips it, so it never breaks during GENERATE; GenerateCore presents every CH, FINAL's first, at the first GENERATE, and TerminateCore runs ProcessControlFootings(0), which ends with FINAL's footing and its RESET ON FINAL reset. The FINAL semantics take the same arm at 85 and 2023; the edition arms on the path are the TYPE operand forms and the RESET level screen, both matching the 1985 text in the probes. Class a (variable length) and e (file organizations) do not apply: FINAL names no data item and the report file is sequential output only.
reader.at-2023: p1final and x1cycles print identically at --std 2023; p2finalkey is refused at 2023 by COBOL6824 (RESET ON FINAL in CF FINAL), as §2023:13.18.54.3 SR8 requires

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR1-GR4, §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR4, §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR4 and GR6, §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR4 and §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR1/GR2; cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR4  (3.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4', 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR6  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6'. Attacked what the reader's probes did not try with E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/read-xiii374/probes/x1cycles.cob at --std 85 (CONTROL IS FINAL, a PH carrying PAGE-COUNTER, an 8-line page forcing a page advance, two INITIATE/TERMINATE cycles, the second by GENERATE report-name summary reporting): report 'PH 01 / CH-F / D=01 D=02 D=03 / form feed / PH 02 / D=04 .. D=07 / CF-F 028 / PH 01 / CH-F / CF-F 030'. CH FINAL follows the PH at the first GENERATE and is not repeated after the page advance (1985 has no OR PAGE); CF FINAL is presented once per TERMINATE as the last body group; the RESET ON FINAL-level SUM resets between cycles (28, then 10+20=30); INITIATE clears every prior (ReportWriter.Initiate) so CH FINAL is presented again in cycle 2. Identical at --std 2023. Grepped DialectLevel, DialectBehaviors, IsActive, Cite and ConstructRegistry in ReportWriter.cs and in the FINAL members of ReportSectionBinder.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs: the arms on the FINAL path are the ones the reader lists (ScreenResetLevel's < 2002, the VCP TYPE operand gates); the runtime path consults the edition only for NEXT GROUP and GROUP INDICATE, which FINAL does not reach. Every refusal the 1985 text demands for FINAL (after a data-name, twice, CF FINAL or RESET ON FINAL without FINAL in CONTROL, two CF FINAL, CF ON FINAL, bare CF) is refused, and RESET ON FINAL inside CF FINAL is admitted at 85 as SR4 permits. No overturn found.
